note: Directory of well-known modelling poses. Claude tags each analysed photo with the ids that apply (most characteristic first). Shared with the Posey app (copied into app/src/main/assets/poses/). Add entries freely; never reuse or rename an id.

poses.name: Contrapposto
poses.description: Weight on one leg, the other relaxed; hips and shoulders tilt in opposite directions (classic S-curve).

poses.name: Power stance
poses.description: Feet planted wide, at or beyond shoulder width; confident and square.

poses.name: Feet together
poses.description: Straight, symmetrical stance with feet close together; editorial and neutral.

poses.name: Crossed legs
poses.description: Standing with one leg crossed in front of the other at the knee, shin or ankle.

poses.name: Flamingo
poses.description: Standing on one leg with the other knee bent and foot lifted off the ground.

poses.name: Leg pop
poses.description: One knee bent forward with the heel lifted, toe touching the ground.

poses.name: On tiptoe
poses.description: Both heels lifted, weight on the balls of the feet.

poses.name: Three-quarter turn
poses.description: Body angled about 45° away from the camera, face toward it.

poses.name: Profile
poses.description: Body turned side-on to the camera, about 90°.

poses.name: Back view
poses.description: Back to the camera, often looking over the shoulder.

poses.name: Hand on hip
poses.description: One hand resting on the hip or waist, elbow out (forms a triangle).

poses.name: Hands on hips
poses.description: Both hands on the hips or waist, elbows out (the 'superhero' pose).

poses.name: Arms crossed
poses.description: Arms folded across the chest.

poses.name: Hands in pockets
poses.description: One or both hands in pockets or tucked into the waistband.

poses.name: Hand in hair
poses.description: One hand on or behind the head, in the hair, elbow raised.

poses.name: Hands in hair
poses.description: Both hands on or behind the head, elbows raised.

poses.name: Hand to face
poses.description: Hand touching the face, chin, cheek, jaw or lips.

poses.name: Arms raised
poses.description: One or both arms lifted high or stretched overhead.

poses.name: Arms relaxed
poses.description: Arms hanging loosely by the sides.

poses.name: Collar or lapel grab
poses.description: Hands holding the collar, lapel, jacket edge or neckline.

poses.name: Holding an accessory
poses.description: Holding or showing a bag, hat, sunglasses or other prop.

poses.name: Over the shoulder
poses.description: Looking back at the camera over one shoulder.

poses.name: Head tilt
poses.description: Head clearly tilted to one side.

poses.name: Chin up
poses.description: Head lifted, chin raised, gaze upward or past the camera.

poses.name: Gaze down
poses.description: Eyes or head lowered, looking down.

poses.name: Looking away
poses.description: Face or eyes turned away from the camera.

poses.name: Walking / mid-stride
poses.description: Caught mid-step, as in a runway walk.

poses.name: Twirl
poses.description: Spinning, with hair or garment swinging out.

poses.name: Jump
poses.description: Feet off the ground mid-jump.

poses.name: Seated on a chair
poses.description: Sitting on a chair, stool or ledge.

poses.name: Seated on the floor
poses.description: Sitting on the ground or floor.

poses.name: Squat
poses.description: Crouching low with knees bent, heels near the hips.

poses.name: Kneeling
poses.description: One or both knees on the ground.

poses.name: Reclining
poses.description: Lying down or leaning back on the elbows.

poses.name: Wall lean
poses.description: Leaning the back, shoulder or hand against a wall or surface.

poses.name: Forward lean
poses.description: Torso leaning toward the camera from the hips.
